recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16056 unless a future work group decision changes the surrounding compartment URL guidance.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction asking to fix an ambiguous CompartmentDefinition sentence whose original wording failed to say what the specification described when discussing compartment syntax and resource identity.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 5a0301d6ef28e808e9d356289a8f416c1b1f16a6, matching the Jira comments that cite svn revision 14433. That commit changed the sentence from "this specification describes using the compartment syntax" to "while this specification describes how to use the compartment syntax" in source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-notes.xml.
additional_context: CompartmentDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to FHIR-I. Later edits to the same notes file clarified adjacent compartment URL behavior but did not reverse the FHIR-16056 wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community evidence or conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-notes.xml:95-97 already contains the corrected wording and preserves the intended resource-identity rule.
